### Auto-generated by the `compareRovbaseData` function from the `rovquantR` package on `r Sys.Date()`


```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
#results <- readRDS(params$results_file)
results <- info.ls

summary_tbl <- results$summary
column_comparison <- results$column_comparison
dup1 <- results$duplicate_keys_dataset1
dup2 <- results$duplicate_keys_dataset2
keys_only_1 <- results$keys_only_in_dataset1
keys_only_2 <- results$keys_only_in_dataset2
rows_only_1 <- results$rows_only_in_dataset1
rows_only_2 <- results$rows_only_in_dataset2
changed_rows <- results$changed_rows_summary
diff_table <- results$cell_level_differences
keys <- results$keys
compared_columns <- results$compared_columns
file1 <- results$file1
file2 <- results$file2
sheet1 <- results$sheet1
sheet2 <- results$sheet2

pretty_kable <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat('<em>No rows.</em>')
  } else {
    kable(df, caption = caption) %>%
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
  }
}
```
